observation.quality_finding: Displayed aggregate open interest spans approximately $0.836B to $2.92B, a roughly 3.5x range. This is not enough to conclude that any source is wrong: timestamps, venue coverage, linear/inverse contracts, perps versus dated futures and quote-currency conversions may differ. The feature must remain excluded until a harmonized contract universe is defined.
observation.next_test: Reconstruct per-exchange/per-contract OI at a common UTC cutoff, preserve source raw payload hashes, distinguish perpetuals from dated futures and options, normalize USD/USDT/USDC conversions, and compare the summed contract-level series to each vendor.
